changelog.title: OpenAnyDoc Changelog – New CSV, Excel, JSON & TXT Features
changelog.description: See what's new in OpenAnyDoc: free online CSV, Excel (XLSX), JSON and TXT viewers and editors, with every new feature listed by release.
changelog.heading: OpenAnyDoc changelog: what's new in our online CSV, Excel, JSON and TXT editors
changelog.intro: Every new feature of our free online file viewers and editors, newest release first. Your files stay private: they are never uploaded.
changelog.toolbars: Icon toolbars for editing CSV, TXT, JSON and Excel files
changelog.whatsNew: This page, the announcement banner and the “New” badges
highlights.csv.open: Open CSV, TSV and tab files online with automatic delimiter detection
highlights.csv.edit: Edit CSV cells, rows and columns with find and replace and clean-up tools
highlights.csv.large: Open large CSV files with 100,000+ rows without slowing down
highlights.text.view: View text files online with line numbers, search and font choices
highlights.text.edit: Edit TXT files: change case, sort lines, remove duplicate lines and tidy spaces
highlights.text.endings: Choose LF or CRLF line endings before you save your text file
highlights.json.views: View JSON online as a tree, a table or formatted code
highlights.json.edit: Edit JSON: sort keys and lists, duplicate or move nodes, and choose the indentation
highlights.json.errors: Validate JSON and see the line and column of any error
highlights.excel.open: Open XLSX, XLS, XLSM and ODS files online with sheets, merged cells and styles
highlights.excel.edit: Edit Excel cells and formulas that recalculate, and save in the same format
highlights.excel.format: Change number formats, currencies, fonts, colours and borders in Excel files
